phase: Kanban column moves and primary tag correction

not_confirmed: Global tag ordering and hierarchy precedence.

implementation: Use one primary tag column while retaining every task tag and the same task identity.
Apply typed date, priority, list, tag and custom-section column moves through shared actions.
Preserve the timed interval, absolute reminder offset and independent deadline when rescheduling.
Move parent and children to a list with one undo; retain child identities and parent relations.
Highlight writable columns and declare in-app card drags as move operations.
skip_reasons: Four real Pi meeting service integrations are not enabled.
One property-panel focus test requires a foreground test host.

observed: The multi-tag QA task appears once under 本周 with both 本周 and 验收 metadata.
Column counts are 本周 6, 验收 1, 无标签 2.
Dragging 本周 to 验收 changed column counts from 6/1 to 5/2 and retained only 验收 on the QA task; undo and redo were observed.
Dragging the QA task to 无标签 removed both tags and changed its column count from 2 to 3; one undo restored both tags and original counts.
The rebuilt app changed from priority grouping to tag grouping immediately after selecting the menu item, without navigation or a task mutation.
The user completed the priority drag in the final build; native AX, REA screenshot and persisted task priority agreed.
The date panel opened and Escape cancelled its unsaved range draft; the persisted 10:30–11:30 interval remained unchanged.
pending: Native pointer gestures for date, list and custom-section destinations; their shared domain transaction paths pass automated tests.

live_preferences_fix: Forward nested view preference invalidation through AppEnvironment so grouping, view mode and detail changes redraw without a task mutation.
drag_protocol: Native NSDraggingDestination accepts an existing task payload synchronously and prefers move; legacy copy sources keep the shared domain move semantics.

release_preview_fix.reported_by_user: On release, the drag image slowly slides into the destination and lingers over the inserted card.
release_preview_fix.native_contract: Set NSDraggingInfo.animatesToDestination=false during prepareForDragOperation; AppKit removes accepted drag images without animation before performDragOperation.
implementation: Host each column in a native drop destination, forwarding the SwiftUI environment and retaining controls.
Read the task payload synchronously and apply the existing shared move action in a transaction with animations disabled.
Accept same-column releases without mutation or undo history; clear only the highlight when dragging exits.
Keep the normal system preview while the pointer is still dragging.
coverage: Animation flag changes during prepare before any task mutation; perform completes the original task move synchronously.
One undo and redo, accepted same-column release with no undo, and exit preserving the preview.
Card selection, checkbox completion, date panel and secondary-click menu work inside the native host.
Actual board column quick-add receives keyboard focus, preserves priority and supports continued input.

implemented: Compute native insertion feedback from live card and viewport geometry.
Reorder siblings in manual mode without changing parent membership.
Combine insertion and destination attributes into one publication and one undo.
Keep field sorting authoritative; do not rewrite manual order in field-sorted mode.
Retain immediate drag preview removal on accepted release.
